title: Elon Musk spent nearly $500 million on the midterms and lost big-time

claims.claim: Elon Musk, Forbes tarafından bildirilen FEC dosyalarına göre Cumhuriyetçi adayları seçtirmek için yaklaşık 500 milyon dolar harcadı.

evidence.quote: The Tesla CEO spent nearly $500 million to elect Republican candidates, according to FEC filings reported on by Forbes.

claims.claim: Elon Musk, seçimlerde Dick ve Liz Uihlein çiftinden üç kat daha fazla bağış yaparak en büyük bireysel bağışçı oldu.

evidence.quote: Musk was the election's single largest individual donor by a vast margin, dwarfing the second-place billionaire couple Dick and Liz Uihlein by more than a factor of three.

claims.claim: CNBC raporuna göre Elon Musk, Teksas bölgesine yaklaşık 225 milyon dolar aktardı.

evidence.quote: All told, Musk funneled around $225 million to the region, according to a report by CNBC.
Much of his money was spent in his adopted home of Texas. All told, Musk funneled around $225 million to the region, according to a report by CNBC.

claims.claim: Elon Musk, 106 Temsilciler Meclisi ve Senato yarışında Cumhuriyetçi adayları destekledi.

evidence.quote: He put his support behind Republicans in 106 House and Senate races.

claims.claim: Elon Musk'ın desteklediği adaylardan 18'i seçimi kazandı, 45'i kaybetti ve 43 yarış henüz sonuçlanmadı.

evidence.quote: As of right now, 18 of those people have won and they were primarily in extremely safe red areas. He lost 45 races and another 43 are yet to be called

He put his support behind Republicans in 106 House and Senate races. As of right now, 18 of those people have won and they were primarily in extremely safe red areas. He lost 45 races and another 43 are yet to be called

claims.claim: Elon Musk, 4 Kasım 2026 tarihinde X platformunda seçimlere müdahale eden uzay lazerleri hakkında bir paylaşım yaptı.

evidence.quote: Guess my election-interfering space lasers didn't work this time 🤷♂️ — Elon Musk (@elonmusk) November 4, 2026

claims.claim: Elon Musk'ın mevcut servetinin yaklaşık 898 milyar dolar olduğu belirtiliyor.

evidence.quote: Elon Musk is currently worth around $898 billion.
